📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy

Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements

Asset Preparation & Coordination

Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework

Creative Intelligence & Testing

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs

Tracking & Measurement

Team Flexibility

Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale

Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams

Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously

As a Lead Digital Marketing Manager, you will take ownership of Ounass's cross-channel paid media investment strategy, ensuring our marketing budgets are allocated effectively to drive sustainable growth, customer acquisition and commercial performance.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, you will be responsible for defining budget allocation frameworks, establishing measurement standards, leading incrementality testing and owning the paid media forecast across our six GCC markets.

Working closely with our Paid Search, Paid Social, Influencer Marketing and other channel leads, you will set the investment direction, performance expectations and measurement frameworks that guide their execution.

This is a highly analytical and commercially focused role requiring someone who can translate complex marketing data into clear investment decisions, challenge existing measurement approaches and confidently present recommendations to senior leadership and Finance.

What You'll Be Doing

Paid Media Investment & Budget Allocation

Own and manage the cross-channel paid media budget across Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Programmatic, Affiliates and Influencer Marketing, covering the UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman and Bahrain.
Define investment allocation frameworks, marginal efficiency targets, growth expectations and customer acquisition cost (CAC) thresholds to guide channel-level decisions.
Lead the budget reallocation process through weekly pacing reviews, monthly investment rebalancing and quarterly resets aligned with business forecasts.
Analyse channel and market performance to identify opportunities to optimise investment, improve returns and support business growth.
Partner with Finance and Retail Media to distinguish brand-funded investment from Ounass-funded spend, ensuring accurate reporting of Net DM.
Balance short-term performance efficiency with longer-term upper-funnel investment, assessing the commercial impact, expected returns and payback periods.
Apply marginal economics and diminishing-returns analysis to inform investment decisions across performance marketing channels.

Marketing Measurement & Incrementality

Establish and own the measurement framework used to evaluate paid media performance and guide budget allocation decisions.
Lead the incrementality testing programme across key marketing channels, including geo holdout experiments, conversion lift studies and other testing methodologies.
Partner with BI and Data teams to design experiments, interpret results and translate findings into actionable investment recommendations.
Own the application and interpretation of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) insights, identifying opportunities to improve channel allocation and overall marketing effectiveness.
Bring together insights from platform attribution, GA4, app measurement platforms such as Adjust, and MMM to create a consistent view of marketing performance.
Develop and interpret diminishing-returns curves across channels and markets to understand where additional investment generates incremental value.
Work with Technology, BI and Data teams to ensure measurement accuracy across server-side tracking, consent management, app attribution and SKAdNetwork.
Challenge attribution discrepancies and investigate data quality issues that could affect investment decisions.

Forecasting & Strategic Planning

Own the weekly, monthly and annual paid media forecasts across channels and markets, with accountability for forecast accuracy.
Lead the paid media planning process, providing accurate investment assumptions and performance projections for annual budgets and business reforecasts.
Build investment scenarios that demonstrate the commercial impact of increasing, reducing or reallocating marketing budgets.
Work with channel leads to establish market and channel-level performance targets aligned with overall business objectives.
Partner closely with Finance to ensure marketing forecasts are commercially sound, measurable and aligned with business planning.
Present and defend investment recommendations, forecasts and assumptions to senior leadership.

Own the paid media performance narrative for the VP Marketing, Finance and other key stakeholders, clearly communicating performance drivers, risks and recommended actions.
Partner with BI to develop a consistent source of truth for marketing performance reporting, reducing fragmented reporting and ensuring alignment across teams.
Translate complex performance data into clear, actionable recommendations that support investment and commercial decisions.
Provide category-level and brand-level investment insights to Commercial and Retail Media teams.
Support key trading moments, including Ramadan, Eid, private sales and peak trading periods, through investment planning, performance analysis and forecasting.
Develop concise, decision-focused reporting that allows leadership and channel teams to act quickly and confidently.

AI, Automation & Marketing Effectiveness

Identify opportunities to automate performance reporting, budget pacing alerts, forecasting and investment allocation recommendations.
Use AI and automation tools to improve analytical efficiency, streamline workflows and reduce manual reporting.
Establish appropriate guardrails and measurement frameworks for platform-led automation, assessing performance against manual approaches.
Continuously explore emerging technologies, analytical tools and measurement methodologies to improve marketing effectiveness.
Measure and demonstrate the efficiency gains achieved through AI and automation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance

Work closely with channel leads, Finance, BI, Data, Growth, Commercial and Retail Media teams to ensure alignment on investment priorities and performance expectations.
Manage and coordinate measurement initiatives involving Marketing Mix Modelling, lift studies and external marketing platform measurement teams.
Establish and document clear standards for budget allocation, experiment design, forecasting and reporting.
Ensure marketing investment decisions remain aligned with Ounass's luxury positioning, brand standards and long-term business objectives.
Challenge investment opportunities or placements that may deliver short-term efficiency but compromise brand perception.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Expertise

8+ years of experience in performance marketing, with proven ownership of significant multi-channel paid media budgets, ideally within a scaled e-commerce or consumer business.
Strong experience developing cross-channel investment strategies, allocating budgets across markets and demonstrating measurable commercial returns.
Proven hands-on experience designing, evaluating and acting on incrementality studies, including geo holdouts and conversion lift experiments.

Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership.

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy

Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements

Asset Preparation & Coordination

Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework

Creative Intelligence & Testing

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs

Tracking & Measurement

Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines

Team Flexibility

Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.

Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale

Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously

Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy

Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements

Asset Preparation & Coordination

Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework

Creative Intelligence & Testing

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs

Tracking & Measurement

Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines

Team Flexibility

Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.

What We're Looking For

4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models
